<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex040012026-09-0405-31-06" status="unreviewed">shis yid spyod na thun
            mong pa ni brgyad de | nyen pa gal chu pa'i myigs 1 dang | nye bar brtan pas dbye ba
            dang | 'dod can khyod pa'i so bo'i skye bo'i phyogs 1 dang | mos pa spyod pa can gyi
            gang zag dang <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="247b8"/> la go ba'i ses skye bor gyi shogs pa na || byod pa dang
            yang lnga shun mong ni phyer bas dbye ba na || yang khung zhugs dang mthong pa myi thob
            yin na spyi yod na chol gyi sngos pa'i phyi man te na | tho ba la shas pa | rgyun tu
            thug pas thug 'bras bu dang | de ltar sogs na srid pa lan bdun pa rnam shes te shes nges
            par byed pa'i sha dang 'jug pa stan 1 pa nas bzung nas shes pa ltar na thugs <lb n="247b9"/> zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la 'jug pa 'ang sbyor laM dangmthong laM thun mong bar mngon no zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3864">skyabs</rs> gsung ngo ||</seg></TEI>
